audience: operations teams and analysts using Weatherbit commercial APIs

useCases.title: Plan around upcoming weather
useCases.text: Read current conditions and daily or hourly forecasts for a coordinate, including temperature, precipitation and wind.

useCases.title: Compare historical weather
useCases.text: Retrieve daily historical conditions over a bounded date range to compare temperature and precipitation across periods.

useCases.title: Inspect air-quality conditions
useCases.text: Read current pollutant concentrations and hourly air-quality forecasts for a coordinate when your Weatherbit plan includes access.

useCases.title: Review agriculture and energy forecasts
useCases.text: Retrieve agriculture and energy forecast data, including soil, evapotranspiration, degree-day and irradiance fields supported by your subscription.

useCases.title: Check remaining API quota
useCases.text: Read usage counters and reset times before planning further lookups. The usage check itself consumes one standard Weatherbit request.
